findings.why_it_matters: The page's running header is rendered as a level-1 markdown heading, which adds a spurious top-level 'Index' section to the outline at XVIII-6; every sibling index page (807-811, 813, 814) keeps the running header as plain text.
findings.note: Running header 'Index' at the top left of folio XVIII-6, not a heading. The base index body on pages 807-819 is deliberately deleted by the transcription's Errata C337 (Amendment 2 replaces the index), so the empty index pages are not findings; only this header promotion is.
